messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Runtime alert CB-4779: high KV cache eviction rate and rising p95 for cont-batch pool eu-central-1. Error rate jumped from 0.6% -> 3.7% in 8m.

kara: I'm oncall. pulling recent config diffs. liam, can you grab the topology + affected hosts?

liam: grabbing. appears config terraform apply 3h ago updated continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens=16384 and request_timeout_ms lowered to 12000. Why lower timeout? that may cause preempted tours.

mona: lowered timeout was from a separate perf-tuning change. someone tried to reduce tail latency but didn't account for KV cache growth with larger batch token cap.

nate: customer impact: a partner webhook batch job failed intermittently — three retries for one customer. filing incident-impact for the account.

olga: quick mitigation steps I propose: 1) bump request_timeout_ms back to 30000 to avoid mid-request preemption, 2) reduce max_batch_tokens to 4096, 3) set max_num_seqs to 6, 4) enable aggressive kv evict policy.

deploy-bot: running: `cfg apply emergency-eu-1818002600` -> in progress

kara: toggling FF for cont-batch in eu-central-1 to off.

deploy-bot: `ff toggle continuous_batching --pools eu-central-1 --state off` -> success at 1818002702

liam: applying config patch:
```yaml
continuous_batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_num_seqs: 6
  request_timeout_ms: 30000
  kv_cache_eviction_policy: aggressive
```

deploy-bot: emergency config apply done: status success.

mona: initiating cache eviction and rolling restarts. starting with the highest mem hosts.

kara: monitoring: p95 dropping after evictions, error rate trending down. two hosts had OOMs and were replaced.

liam: RCA sketch: compounding changes across two independent deploys — one increased batch_tokens, another lowered timeouts. Combined effect: large prefixes kept plus shorter timeouts causing retries and more load -> cache churn and evictions -> latency and 5xxs.

nate: customer comms sent. Partner impacted had a delayed batch; recovery confirmed.

olga: immediate follow-ups: add a check in PR CI that flags concurrent cont-batch config changes within 24h and forces an ops review; add server-side clamp for request_timeout_ms min 15000 and max_batch_tokens cap 16384 unless flagged.

mona: also adding a real-time probe in production that simulates a long-prefix request every 5m per pool to surface cache growth risk.

incident-bot: CB-4779 mitigated at 1818006068. Severity: Sev4 (some impact to partner workflows). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/CB-4779

kara: handing to mona for postmortem writeup. we'll schedule follow-up with dev teams who pushed the changes.

liam: noted — will add host-level metrics and KV cache alerts to the runbook.
